say:0:1013508001:0.text: The golems we faced before seemed more like finished products.
say:0:1013508001:0.source_cn: 我们之前遇到的魔偶，似乎更接近于“成品”。

say:1:1013508002:0.text: Clearly, someone's secretly pulling the strings of the completed golems.
say:1:1013508002:0.source_cn: 那些”完整“魔偶的背后，显然有人在暗中操控。
say:1:1013508002:0.male: Clearly, someone's secretly pulling the strings of the completed golems.
say:1:1013508002:0.female: Clearly, someone's secretly pulling the strings of the completed golems.

say:2:1013508003:0.text: Someone's deliberately using them to attack civilians? How evil!
say:2:1013508003:0.source_cn: 故意控制它们去攻击民众？艾雅在上……一定要让我们揪出这...
